t: DEWALT Extreme Straight Shank Metal Drill Bits are high-speed steel (HSS) bits designed for efficient and precise drilling in metal and stainless steel. These durable 2.5mm drill bits feature an optimised tip geometry that ensures faster material penetration and rapid dust removal, significantly reducing heat build-up for extended tool life. Ideal for professional metalworkers and electricians, the hardened construction and split-point tip provide reliable performance. A no-spin shank ensures stability during use, and the bits are suitable for both rotary and impact drilling modes, offering versatility on various job sites.
